{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove QA rows with revenue = '999999.99'
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA rows (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_rows))

df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# Parse revenue as float
# Remove commas and convert
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Subset to converted == 1
converted_df = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]
print("Number of converted customers (after QA removal):", len(converted_df))

# Exclude rows with customer_age == -1 (missing data)
converted_valid_age = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]
print("Number of converted customers with valid age:", len(converted_valid_age))

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()
print("Mean age of converted customers with valid age:", mean_age)

# Output for evidence
print("\nEVIDENCE:")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(converted_valid_age)}")
print(f"Mean age: {mean_age}")"}
